title: Lesson plans
subtitle: Your teaching day, annual roadmaps and daily lesson plans
queueSubtitle: Annual roadmaps and weekly plans across your scope
noBranch: Select a branch to see its lesson plans.

myDay.emptyHint: Your timetable periods appear here with their lesson plans.
myDay.noTimetable: No published timetable for this day — showing your classes instead.
myDay.noAnnualPlan: Create the annual plan for this subject first — see the Plans tab.
myDay.weekLocked: This week's plan is already submitted. Open it from the Plans tab.

day.title: Daily lesson plan
day.topicPlaceholder: What is taught in this lesson
day.objectivesHint: At the end of this lesson the students will be able to…
day.lastSection: A lesson needs at least one section.
day.stagesHint: How the period runs — the opening, the main work, and the close.
day.supportSlow: For students who need more help
day.autosaveHint: Changes save automatically while you type.
day.aiDrafted: Draft filled in — review every field before submitting.
day.duplicateHint: Copies the lesson's content to another day — for a class that missed it, or to continue an unfinished topic.
day.markSourceMissed: Mark this day's unfinished classes as not covered

register.subject: Subject
register.emptyHint: The annual plan is the year's roadmap — chapters, timelines and goals. Create one for each subject you teach.

create.title: New annual plan
create.description: Pick one of your classes — one plan covers every section you teach of that subject and grade.
create.goalsPlaceholder: What should students achieve by the end of the year?
create.methodsPlaceholder: The main methods you will use — explanation, group work, experiments…
create.noOptions: No teaching assignments found for you this year.

aiUnits.title: Draft the year's units
aiUnits.chaptersPlaceholder: Paste the textbook chapter list or describe the topics — leave empty to follow the standard curriculum.
aiUnits.selectHint: Untick any unit you don't want. Tap a card to see the full details.

plan.unitsHint: The chapter roadmap — daily lessons are measured against these timelines.
plan.noUnitsHint: Break the syllabus into chapters with timelines before submitting.
plan.weeksHint: One container per week — the daily lessons inside it are what you submit for review.
plan.noWeeksHint: Once the annual plan is approved, plan each day from its units.
plan.declineDescription: Tell the teacher what to fix — the reason is recorded and sent to them.
plan.declineReasonPlaceholder: What must change before this plan can be approved?
plan.lockedHint: Approved plans are read-only. Reopen to edit — weekly plans stay.
plan.confirmDelete: This deletes the annual plan and its units. Weekly plans already filed are kept in the archive.
plan.submitNeedsUnits: Add at least one unit before submitting.

unit.title: Unit title
unit.objectivesPlaceholder: What students master in this unit
unit.rationalePlaceholder: What this unit prepares students for
unit.confirmDelete: Remove this unit from the roadmap?

week.notesPlaceholder: Anything the director should know about this week (optional)
week.confirmDelete: Delete this week's plan and its daily lessons?
week.carryoverHint: These lessons were not fully covered last week. Copy them into this week or justify the delay below.
week.gateHint: You cannot submit this week while last week has uncovered lessons — explain the delay and the reviewer will decide.
week.justificationPlaceholder: Why is the class behind schedule? e.g. holiday, exams, closure…
week.coverageHint: After each class runs, mark what was actually taught. Uncovered lessons carry into next week.
week.planNotApproved: The annual plan must be approved before weekly plans can be submitted.

review.title: Review inbox
review.description: Submitted plans waiting for your decision
review.emptyHint: Submitted annual and weekly plans will appear here.

pacingBoard.title: Pacing & accountability
pacingBoard.description: Planned vs covered periods per teacher, from approved plans
pacingBoard.subject: Subject
pacingBoard.emptyHint: Pacing is measured against approved annual plans.

family.title: Class plan
family.description: What each subject is covering and what is planned this week
family.noWeek: No plan published for this week yet.
family.noPlan: The teacher has not published a plan for this subject yet.
family.emptyHint: Class plans appear once the student is enrolled in a section.
